The '''Grumani sector''', also known as the '''Spumani sector''', was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
[[File:Grumani_sector_EAOC.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Grumani sector and its surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]]]
The Grumani sector was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. However, during the [[Republic Dark Age]], vast swaths of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] fell under the control of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had a considerable presence in the Grumani sector, which was attacked by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] following the [[Battle of Virujansi]].
